A [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual was a notorious '''pirate''' who had a number of sons, including one named [[Shai Tenna]]. The man's children had an abusive childhood at the hands of their father, and they placed their sons in leadership positions in their [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] crew. However, Tenna gained control over his family's crew by systematically [[Death/Legends|murdering]] his brothers, and eventually became a leader in the [[White Maw]] pirate group.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shai Tenna's father was mentioned in the Codex entry for Shai Tenna in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
